reviews.title: Charged 120 Coins for Failed Videos, No Support Response
reviews.text:
I paid 60 coins each for two video generations, 120 coins total, and both were essentially unusable. One of the videos did not use a single photo that I uploaded, despite those photos being the entire point of the creation.

The app still deducted all 120 coins. I contacted support immediately, explained exactly what happened, and asked for the coins to be restored. Instead of receiving actual assistance, I was given automated help articles that did not address the problem. I specifically asked to speak with someone and followed up multiple times, but received no response.

If a generation fails or completely ignores the material provided by the customer, the coins should be refunded automatically, or at minimum support should review the issue and restore them. Charging customers for failed generations and then ignoring support requests is unacceptable.

I will gladly update my review if they resolve the issue and restore the 120 coins.
